name: Levocetirizine
description: The R-enantiomer of cetirizine, a second-generation peripherally selective H1 antihistamine approved for allergic rhinitis and chronic idiopathic urticaria.

systems.note: Peripheral H1 antagonism blocking the histamine response; the labelled indication.
Predominantly renally excreted unchanged; dose adjustment is labelled.

monitors.why: Predominantly renal excretion with labelled dose adjustment.
